question: In 'How I Taught My Grandmother to Read', Sudha Murty illustrates that passion and determination overcome age barriers. Elaborate with close reference to the text.
options: Sudha Murty presents her grandmother Krishtakka as an inspiring exemplar of lifelong learning. Growing up in an era when
explanation: Sudha Murty presents her grandmother Krishtakka as an inspiring exemplar of lifelong learning. Growing up in an era when female literacy was neglected, Krishtakka was married young and remained uneducated. However, when faced with her inability to read 'Kashi Yatre', she experienced a profound moment of self-awakening. Rather than accepting illiteracy as her permanent fate at age 62, she resolved to learn the Kannada alphabet from scratch. She approached her 12-year-old granddaughter with humility, setting a firm deadline for Saraswati Pooja. Krishtakka worked tirelessly—practicing writing, repeating phonetics, and completing homework despite her household chores. Her triumph on Dussehra demonstrates that true determination and passion can conquer any barrier, proving that age is no bar to acquiring knowledge.
